attributes.name: ypy-preload
attributes.description: Fetches the `GET` response ahead of the request, on the given events, and reuses it when the real request has the same URL and the preload is still fresh. Without a value, an element with `ypy-get` preloads on `mousedown` and `touchstart`.

modifiers.name: timeout:<time>
modifiers.description: How long the preloaded response stays valid. Default `5s`.

config.name: preload.autoBoost
config.description: Preload boosted links without writing `ypy-preload`. Set `false` to turn that off.

config.name: preload.boostTimeout
config.description: How long a preloaded response stays valid for the automatic preload, in milliseconds or as `"5s"`.

config.name: preload.boostEvent
config.description: Event that starts the automatic preload of boosted links and bare `ypy-preload` elements. `touchstart` always does too.
